messages:
Santi: Heads-up — nightly eval picked up a weird quality shift on the new INT8 'spectra' precision profile for llama3-small. Summarize-X prompt set failures jumped, some outputs truncated weirdly. @Maya @Jordan

eval-bot: nightly-eval run_id=482 summary: model=llama3-small profile=int8-spectra failure_rate=0.062 -> baseline=0.014 delta=+0.048 metric=exact_match_drop

Maya: Ack. Any samples?

Santi: Pasting 1 failed sample (float32 vs int8):
```
FLOAT: "In summary, the project achieved all milestones and delivered on time."
INT8 : "In summary, the project achieved all milestones and delivered on <EOS>"
```
Looks like premature EOS tokens and token-prob spikes.

Jordan: Might be kv-cache or EOS bias after quant scale. Did we change layernorm folding in the profile?

Maya: The spectra profile changed per-channel scales for qkv and merged layernorm quant params. I flagged a relaxed clipping hyper to avoid saturation. Could cause high-prob EOS if logits scale off.

Lee: I can repro locally — running `./tools/repro --model llama3-small --profile int8-spectra --prompt-file tests/summarize-x/seed1.txt`

Santi: Thanks. Can you attach the logits diffs? Run with `--dump-logits` and gzip.

Lee: uploaded: s3://redwood-nightlies/482/2176543210/logits-diff.tar.gz — early look: layer12 attention logits show a ~3.2x scale difference on EOS token for some prefixes.

Jordan: Hmm layer12 attention — maybe quant params for Q,K scale mismatch. Any per-head outliers?

Lee: yes head 5/11 has an outlier. snippet:
```
head5 logits mean (float)=0.12 std=0.87
head5 logits mean (int8)=0.38 std=1.1
```

Aisha: Assigning owners: Maya to check profile diff, Jordan to run layerwise per-head debug, Lee to produce repro artifacts. I'll follow up with a quick canary rollback if needed. :thumbsup: 

Maya: I ran a small ablation: switching qkv per-channel -> per-tensor reduces failure rate to baseline. So per-channel scaling in spectra seems to be the suspect.

Jordan: Can we try re-calibrating with `--calib-samples 10k --clip 3.5`? Might reduce saturation.

Maya: Doing that now: calib run id=cal-872, preliminary failure_rate=0.017. Better but not identical.

Santi: Good. If re-calib helps, we may need to change the default spectra profile or add a profiling sanity check (EOS-prob delta threshold). Ticket it?

Aisha: Filed ML-5243: "INT8 spectra profile: EOS-prob spike after per-channel qkv scaling" — added logs and owners.

Jordan: Also adding a nightly eval gating rule to alert if EOS token KL divergence > 0.5 for core promptsets.

Santi: Nice. Let's keep this thread for updates. If anyone finds a blocker for dedicated fleet rollouts, ping infra. Thanks.

eval-bot: note: rerun scheduled in 2h (run 483).
